rule: Tech companies at their main Polish office (office = legal seat abroad), the Polish TOP500 systems of November 2026 (one point per computing centre), satellite and space-instrument makers, the 2025 patent leader and the first cloud regions; one fact each, re-read at the source in November 2026.
studio_rule: Active video game studios on Wikidata with their headquarters in a Polish town and at least one game released by 2026; the best-known game has the most Wikipedia sitelinks, checked by hand for the 30 studios with the most sitelinks.

Q15070335.note: Flying Wild Hog: Shadow Warrior (2013), the reboot that made the studio known, over Evil West (2022), which has 4 more sitelinks

Q16594238.note: QLOC: Dark Souls: Remastered (2018, co-developed), over Injustice 2, where QLOC made only the PC port

Q1172164.note: CD Projekt Red: The Witcher 3 (65 million copies, the studio's best seller), over Cyberpunk 2077, which has more sitelinks; Cyberpunk stays in the CD Projekt Red landmark fact

studio_drop.Q7098994: CD Projekt S.A. is the parent company; its studio CD Projekt Red (Q1172164) is listed with its games
studio_drop.Q3339538: Nibris: its only game (Sadness) was never released and the studio closed
studio_drop.Q1502832: Reality Pump Studios closed in 2015 (bankruptcy); Wikidata has no dissolution date. https://www.gamepressure.com/newsroom/reality-pump-studio-behind-two-worlds-ii-goes-bankrupt-and-shuts/z82f

items.name: Cyfronet AGH
items.fact: Helios GPU, number 54 in the world (TOP500, November 2026), is Poland's fastest supercomputer at 53.6 PFlop/s. Cyfronet runs two more listed machines.
items.fact_pl: Helios GPU to 54. superkomputer świata (TOP500, listopad 2026) i najszybszy w Polsce: 53,6 PFlop/s. Cyfronet ma na liście jeszcze dwa systemy.
items.note: Fetched TOP500 Nov 2026 list pages 1-5 and system pages; matches the local t.xlsx. Polish entries: Helios GPU 54, Athena 327, Helios CPU 376 (Cyfronet). Helios GPU rose from 116 (June 2026, 19.1 PFlop/s) to 54 with a new run at 269,280 cores and 53.57 PFlop/s. Coordinates: Cyfronet main building, ul. Nawojki 11 (OSM); Cyfronet also has a 'Data Center Podole' and no source says which building houses Helios.

items.name: PCSS Poznań
items.fact: Proxima at PCSS is number 156 in the world (TOP500, November 2026), with 13.8 PFlop/s. PCSS also runs Altair, number 410.
items.fact_pl: Proxima z PCSS to 156. superkomputer świata (TOP500, listopad 2026), 13,8 PFlop/s. PCSS ma też Altaira na 410. miejscu.
items.note: Proxima: HPE, 58,224 cores, Rmax 13.82 PFlop/s; first listed June 2024 at 76. Altair 410 (3.53 PFlop/s) on list page 5. Coordinates: PCSS building, ul. Jana Pawła II 10 (OSM).

items.name: WCSS Wrocław
items.fact: Lem at WCSS is number 173 in the world (TOP500, November 2026), with 12.8 PFlop/s on Nvidia H100 GPUs.
items.fact_pl: Lem z WCSS to 173. superkomputer świata (TOP500, listopad 2026): 12,8 PFlop/s na kartach Nvidia H100.
items.note: Lem: Dell PowerEdge XE9640, Nvidia H100, 44,992 cores, Rmax 12.80 PFlop/s, installed 2023. WCSS is part of Politechnika Wrocławska. Coordinates: OSM 'Wrocławskie Centrum Sieciowo-Superkomputerowe (WCSS)'.

items.name: Beyond.pl
items.fact: The F.I.N, an AI supercomputer in Beyond.pl's commercial data centre, is number 252 in the world (TOP500, November 2026), with 7.6 PFlop/s.
items.fact_pl: F.I.N, superkomputer AI w komercyjnym centrum danych Beyond.pl, to 252. maszyna świata (TOP500, listopad 2026): 7,6 PFlop/s.
items.note: The F.I.N: NVIDIA DGX B200, 38,880 cores, Rmax 7.57 PFlop/s, installed 2025. Forbes 2025-09-04: on the company's 100 MW campus in Poznań. The only Polish entry in the 'Industry' segment (local t.xlsx; not stated on the fetched system page). Coordinates: Beyond.pl Data Center 2, ul. Kręglewskiego 11 (OSM), which is also the HQ address on beyond.pl/en/contact.

items.name: CI TASK Gdańsk
items.fact: Kraken-Fregata at CI TASK, Gdańsk University of Technology, is number 291 in the world (TOP500, November 2026), with 6.0 PFlop/s.
items.fact_pl: Kraken-Fregata z CI TASK Politechniki Gdańskiej to 291. superkomputer świata (TOP500, listopad 2026): 6,0 PFlop/s.
items.note: Kraken-Fregata: HPE Cray XD665, Nvidia H100, 21,904 cores; Rmax 5.985 PFlop/s (xlsx 5985 TFlop/s; system page shows 5.98, list 5.99). Coordinates: OSM 'Centrum Informatyczne TASK', ul. Narutowicza 11/12.

items.name: SatRev
items.fact: SatRev built the platform of BlueBON, launched in January 2025. SatRev says its camera had imaged over a million square kilometres of Earth by August 2026.
items.fact_pl: SatRev zbudował platformę satelity BlueBON, wystrzelonego w styczniu 2025 r. Według SatRev do sierpnia 2026 r. jego kamera sfotografowała ponad milion kilometrów kwadratowych Ziemi.
items.note: Spidersweb 2026-08-14: SatRev 'zaprojektował i zbudował platformę satelitarną', launch 2025-01-14 (Transporter-12), images cover 'ponad milion kilometrów kwadratowych' (company figure; some places imaged more than once). Payload is from TelePIX (South Korea). The STORK constellation was not used: Wikipedia says all STORK satellites in orbit have decayed. Seat per satrev.space: pl. Strzelecki 25, Wrocław; coordinates from OSM 'SatRev S.A.'.

items.name: Scanway
items.fact: Scanway builds space telescopes. In October 2026 its two-telescope instrument, imaging Earth in visible and infrared light, switched on aboard South Korea's GYEONGGISat-2A.
items.fact_pl: Scanway buduje teleskopy kosmiczne. W październiku 2026 r. jego instrument z dwoma teleskopami, widzący w świetle widzialnym i podczerwieni, ruszył na koreańskim GYEONGGISat-2A.
items.note: wroclaw.pl 2026-10-09: instrument switched on aboard GYEONGGISat-2A (built by Nara Space Technologies, launched 1 October on Falcon 9 Transporter-18); two telescopes for visible and infrared light. Polskie Radio 2024-08-16: Scanway built EagleEye's telescope. Office and seat per scanway.pl: ul. Strzegomska 140A, Wrocław (Nominatim house number).

items.name: Creotech Instruments
items.fact: Creotech built EagleEye, launched in August 2024, and says it is the first satellite over 50 kg designed and built in Poland.
items.fact_pl: Creotech zbudował EagleEye, wystrzelonego w sierpniu 2024 r., i podaje, że to pierwszy zaprojektowany i zbudowany w Polsce satelita o masie ponad 50 kg.
items.note: Creotech 2024-03-21: 'the first satellite designed and built in Poland weighing more than 50 kg'. Polskie Radio 2024-08-16: launched that Friday; Creotech 'led the project and constructed the satellite platform'. Current satellite status not checked (Wikipedia mentions a later data-reception problem). Seat and 'Manufacturing and Integration Facility' per creotech.pl/contact: ul. Jana Pawła II 66, Piaseczno (OSM building).

items.name: KP Labs
items.fact: Intuition-1, launched in November 2023, carries KP Labs' 192-band hyperspectral camera and an AI computer that analyses images in orbit.
items.fact_pl: Intuition-1, wystrzelony w listopadzie 2023 r., ma kamerę hiperspektralną KP Labs (192 pasma) i komputer AI, który analizuje zdjęcia już na orbicie.
items.note: kplabs.space/intuition-1: 6U satellite 'developed by KP Labs', launched November 2023 (SpaceX Transporter-9), 192-band sensor and Leopard AI data processing unit, both KP Labs payloads. The satellite bus came from AAC Clyde Space (Wikipedia, SpaceNews), so the fact credits KP Labs with the payloads only. Seat per KP Labs privacy policy (search result): ul. Bojkowska 37J, Gliwice; coordinates from OSM 'KP Labs'.

items.name: CBK PAN
items.fact: GLOWS, built here, flies on NASA's IMAP probe; the science ministry calls it the first fully Polish research instrument. It recorded first light on 13 November 2025.
items.fact_pl: GLOWS, zbudowany w CBK PAN, leci na sondzie NASA IMAP; resort nauki nazywa go pierwszym w pełni polskim instrumentem badawczym. Pierwsze światło zarejestrował 13 listopada 2025 r.
items.note: gov.pl 2025-12-17: GLOWS built at CBK PAN, one of ten IMAP instruments, first light 2025-11-13, maps the solar wind. gov.pl 2025-09-24: 'pierwszy w pełni polski instrument badawczy'. Alternative fact (ESA 2014 page): CBK PAN built Lem and Heweliusz, the first two Polish scientific satellites (BRITE), each under 10 kg. The 'over 70/80 instruments' count was not fetched from a working page (POLSA 404, dzieje.pl 403). Coordinates: OSM, ul. Bartycka 18A.

items.name: Politechnika Lubelska
items.fact: Politechnika Lubelska won 128 Polish patents in 2025, more than any other applicant, Polish or foreign. Next: Politechnika Rzeszowska (108) and Warszawska (81).
items.fact_pl: Politechnika Lubelska uzyskała w 2025 r. 128 patentów w UPRP, najwięcej ze wszystkich zgłaszających, krajowych i zagranicznych. Dalej: Politechnika Rzeszowska (108) i Warszawska (81).
items.note: UPRP annual report 2025, table 1.13 'Ranking krajowych i zagranicznych podmiotów zgłaszających według liczby patentów udzielonych w 2025 r.': 128, 108, 81. Fetched PDF text matches the local copy. 'Polish or foreign' follows the table title (it covers foreign applicants). Coordinates: Rektorat, ul. Nadbystrzycka 38D (OSM).

items.name: Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure
items.fact: Google opened its first Polish cloud region in Warsaw in April 2021. Microsoft's Azure Poland Central region followed in April 2023.
items.fact_pl: W kwietniu 2021 r. Google otworzył w Warszawie swój pierwszy region chmury w Polsce. Region Microsoft Azure Poland Central ruszył w kwietniu 2023 r.
items.label: First cloud regions
items.seat_note: Data-centre sites are not public; the pin is Warsaw city centre. Microsoft says its region uses three locations around Warsaw.
items.note: Google blog 2021-04-15 (https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/infrastructure/google-cloud-region-in-warsaw-poland-is-now-open/) says 'first Google Cloud region in Poland', three zones; it does not say 'first in CEE'. Techzine 2021-04-15 says 'the first cloud region in central and eastern Europe' and ~USD 2.0 bn investment. Microsoft 2023-04-26 calls Poland Central 'the first in Central and Eastern Europe', which conflicts with Google's earlier region; the fact gives Google the 'first'. Coordinates: Warsaw city centre (Nominatim label point, near the Palace of Culture), not the draft's east-bank centroid.

items.name: CD Projekt Red
items.fact: The Witcher 3 has sold over 65 million copies and Cyberpunk 2077 over 40 million. The whole Witcher series tops 90 million (2026).
items.fact_pl: Wiedźmin 3 sprzedał się w ponad 65 mln egzemplarzy, a Cyberpunk 2077 w ponad 40 mln. Cała seria Wiedźmin przekroczyła 90 mln (2026).
items.note: H1 2026 release: Witcher 3 'over 65 million', Cyberpunk 2077 'crossed the 40 million', series 'surpassed 90 million'. The newer Q3 2026 release (2026-11-24) gives no unit sales, so H1 stays current. Added the series total. Coordinates: OSM 'CD Projekt Red', ul. Jagiellońska 74.

items.name: Allegro
items.fact: Allegro had 21 million active buyers in 2025, 15.3 million of them in Poland, choosing from over 80 million products.
items.fact_pl: W 2025 r. Allegro miało 21 mln aktywnych kupujących, w tym 15,3 mln w Polsce. Mogli wybierać spośród ponad 80 mln produktów.
items.note: Point: Allegro sp. z o.o., KRS 0000635012, seat Poznań, ul. Wierzbięcice 1B (KRS API, state 05.11.2026). The listed parent Allegro.eu S.A. is in Luxembourg; the operating company and HQ are in Poznań.

items.name: InPost
items.fact: InPost ran 28,165 parcel lockers in Poland at the end of 2025, and 61,196 across Europe.
items.fact_pl: Na koniec 2025 r. InPost miał w Polsce 28 165 paczkomatów, a w całej Europie 61 196.
items.note: Point: InPost sp. z o.o., KRS 0000543759, seat Kraków, ul. Pana Tadeusza 4 (Ocean Office Park). The listed parent InPost S.A. is in Luxembourg.

items.name: Text (LiveChat)
items.fact: Founded in Wrocław in 2002 as LiveChat, Text sells chat software to 30,000+ businesses in over 150 countries (2026).
items.fact_pl: Text, założony we Wrocławiu w 2002 r. jako LiveChat, sprzedaje oprogramowanie do czatu ponad 30 tys. firm w ponad 150 krajach (2026).
items.note: Point: Text S.A., KRS 0000290756, seat Wrocław, ul. Zwycięska 47. Customer and country counts are company figures as of 2026.

items.name: Booksy
items.fact: Polish-founded Booksy is used by over 346,000 beauty and wellness businesses in more than 50 countries (2026).
items.fact_pl: Z założonej przez Polaków aplikacji Booksy korzysta ponad 346 tys. firm z branży beauty i wellness w ponad 50 krajach (2026).
items.note: Point: Booksy International sp. z o.o., KRS 0000515914, ul. Prosta 67 (Skyliner), the same building as XTB. ref2 calls Booksy Chicago-headquartered and Poland-founded. No dated valuation found: the $1bn KKR round in search results belongs to Fresha, not Booksy, so no unicorn claim.

items.name: Docplanner (ZnanyLekarz)
items.fact: Docplanner, known in Poland as ZnanyLekarz, booked 25 million doctor appointments in one month across 13 countries (2026).
items.fact_pl: Docplanner, w Polsce znany jako ZnanyLekarz, w ciągu jednego miesiąca umówił 25 mln wizyt lekarskich w 13 krajach (2026).
items.note: The 25 million figure is the live 'last month' counter on docplanner.com (Nov 2026); IT Brief (25 Mar 2026) gives 22 million a month and says the firm was founded in Poland. Point: ZnanyLekarz sp. z o.o., KRS 0000347997, Kolejowa 5/7 (Airtech Business Park), the same building as Packhelp.

items.name: Brainly
items.fact: Brainly, a homework-help platform started in Poland in 2009, had about 15 million daily users in 2024.
items.fact_pl: Brainly, platforma pomocy w odrabianiu lekcji założona w Polsce w 2009 r., miała w 2024 r. ok. 15 mln użytkowników dziennie.
items.note: Figure from the Forbes article of 2024-01-23 (forbes.com refuses automated reads), as quoted in the Wikipedia infobox that cites it

items.name: ElevenLabs
items.fact: Founded in 2022 by two Poles, ElevenLabs was valued at $11 billion in February 2026. In June 2026 Poland's state bank BGK invested $11 million.
items.fact_pl: ElevenLabs, założony w 2022 r. przez dwóch Polaków, był w lutym 2026 r. wyceniany na 11 mld USD. W czerwcu 2026 r. państwowy BGK zainwestował w niego 11 mln USD.
items.note: Valuation: $11bn, Series D announced 4 Feb 2026 (company blog). BGK stake via Vinci, 17 Jun 2026 (Notes from Poland). Warsaw office street address is not public: point is Warsaw centre (Palace of Culture). ElevenLabs Poland sp. z o.o. exists; the company called its Warsaw office its R&D centre and EU headquarters (blog, Nov 2024). EN fact is 25 words.

items.name: Synerise
items.fact: In 2025 the European Investment Bank lent Kraków AI firm Synerise EUR 25 million. The company says it operates in over 150 markets.
items.fact_pl: W 2025 r. Europejski Bank Inwestycyjny pożyczył krakowskiej firmie AI Synerise 25 mln euro. Spółka podaje, że działa na ponad 150 rynkach.
items.note: Venture debt of EUR 25m (PLN 105m), article dated 14.11.2025; the EIB press page returned 403. Company-stated valuation of over $120m (July 2024) left out. Point: Synerise S.A., KRS 0000468034, seat ul. Reymonta 20, Kraków; the company privacy policy reportedly gives Zabłocie 43B (page is script-rendered, not verified).

items.name: Infermedica
items.fact: Wrocław's Infermedica runs AI symptom checks in 35 countries. Its Symptomate became the first app certified by Poland's health ministry in 2024.
items.fact_pl: Wrocławska Infermedica prowadzi wywiady medyczne z AI w 35 krajach. Jej Symptomate jako pierwsza aplikacja w Polsce dostała w 2024 r. certyfikat Ministerstwa Zdrowia.
items.note: Google blog dated 30 Oct 2025 (35 countries, 24 languages, first 'Aplikacja Certyfikowana MZ' in 2024). Company press page: 30M+ health checks, 30+ countries. Point: Infermedica sp. z o.o., KRS 0000429183, Plac Solny 14/3, Wrocław.

items.name: Nomagic
items.fact: In 2025 Warsaw's Nomagic raised $44 million for AI robot arms that pick orders in warehouses for firms such as ASOS.
items.fact_pl: W 2025 r. warszawski Nomagic pozyskał 44 mln USD na roboty z AI, które kompletują zamówienia w magazynach m.in. dla ASOS.
items.note: Round announced 26 Feb 2025, led by the EBRD venture arm. Point: European HQ from the company contact page, Nomagic sp. z o.o., Rakowiecka 36, 02-532 Warszawa. KRS number not found.

items.name: Tidio
items.fact: Tidio, founded in Szczecin in 2013, says over 300,000 companies worldwide use its customer-service chat and AI agent (2026).
items.fact_pl: Tidio, założone w Szczecinie w 2013 r., podaje, że z jego czatu i asystenta AI do obsługi klienta korzysta ponad 300 tys. firm na świecie (2026).
items.note: 300,000 is a company claim (users, not only payers); in May 2022 23,000 businesses paid (ref2). Point: Tidio Poland sp. z o.o., KRS 0000725583, al. Wojska Polskiego 81, Szczecin. The company also lists San Francisco and Warsaw offices.

items.name: Displate
items.fact: Displate, a Warsaw firm, had sold over 11 million metal posters to more than 1.8 million homes and offices by May 2024.
items.fact_pl: Warszawski Displate do maja 2024 r. sprzedał ponad 11 mln metalowych plakatów do ponad 1,8 mln domów i biur.
items.note: Figure from the 11th-birthday release coverage (20 May 2024). Point: GWD Concept sp. z o.o. (Displate operator, KRS 0000451277 per Wikidata P12228), Al. Jerozolimskie 123A, Warszawa.

items.name: Huuuge Games
items.fact: Huuuge's games reach players in 174 countries in 32 languages. Its two casino titles averaged 282,100 daily players in 2025.
items.fact_pl: Gry Huuuge trafiają do graczy ze 174 krajów w 32 językach. Dwa kasynowe tytuły firmy miały w 2025 r. średnio 282,1 tys. graczy dziennie.
items.note: Annual report 2025 (20 Mar 2026): Huuuge Casino and Billionaire Casino 282.1k DAU. Legal seat Dover, Delaware (ref2). Point: Huuuge Games sp. z o.o., KRS 0000248220, ul. Storrady-Świętosławy 1A, Szczecin.

items.name: XTB
items.fact: Warsaw broker XTB won a record 864,000 new clients in 2025 and ended the year with over 2.16 million.
items.fact_pl: Warszawski broker XTB pozyskał w 2025 r. rekordowe 864 tys. nowych klientów i zakończył rok z ponad 2,16 mln klientów.
items.note: Point: XTB S.A., KRS 0000217580, ul. Prosta 67 (Skyliner), the same building as Booksy: the map may need a small offset.

items.name: Netguru
items.fact: Poznań's Netguru says it has delivered over 2,500 software projects since 2008, for clients such as IKEA, Volkswagen and Vinted.
items.fact_pl: Poznański Netguru podaje, że od 2008 r. zrealizował ponad 2500 projektów, m.in. dla IKEA, Volkswagena i Vinted.
items.note: Company claim on its about page (2026). Point: Netguru S.A., KRS 0000745671, Małe Garbary 9 (Nowe Garbary Office Center), Poznań.

items.name: Asseco Poland
items.fact: Rzeszów-based Asseco Group earned PLN 16.8 billion in 2025, and 86% of it came from outside Poland.
items.fact_pl: Grupa Asseco z Rzeszowa miała w 2025 r. 16,8 mld zł przychodów, z czego 86% pochodziło z rynków zagranicznych.
items.note: 86% = Formula Systems plus Asseco International segments (article 31 Mar 2026). Asseco investor pages returned 403. Point: Asseco Poland S.A., KRS 0000033391, ul. Olchowa 14, Rzeszów.

items.name: Comarch
items.fact: Founded in Kraków in 1993, Comarch says brands in over 100 countries on six continents have used its software (2026).
items.fact_pl: Comarch, założony w Krakowie w 1993 r., podaje, że z jego rozwiązań korzystały marki z ponad 100 krajów na sześciu kontynentach (2026).
items.note: Company profile Aug 2026. Seat from the same PDF: Aleja Jana Pawła II 39A, Kraków (KRS 0000057567; the KRS API returned no content for this number).

items.name: Ramp Network
items.fact: Founded in Warsaw in 2017, Ramp Network says over 10 million people have bought or sold crypto through its service.
items.fact_pl: Ramp Network, założony w Warszawie w 2017 r., podaje, że ponad 10 mln osób kupiło lub sprzedało przez niego kryptowaluty.
items.seat_note: operating companies in London and Dublin
items.note: Company claim. Registered offices listed on the page are in London, Dublin and Miami. Point: Ramp Network sp. z o.o., KRS 0000706690, ul. Koszykowa 54, Warszawa.

items.name: Bielik (SpeakLeash)
items.fact: Bielik, a Polish language model with 11 billion parameters, was built by SpeakLeash and trained on Cyfronet's Helios and Athena supercomputers (2024).
items.fact_pl: Bielik, polski model językowy o 11 mld parametrów, stworzyła fundacja SpeakLeash, a trenowano go na superkomputerach Helios i Athena w Cyfronecie (2024).
items.note: Cyfronet news, 28 Aug 2024 (Bielik 11B v2, SpeakLeash with ACK Cyfronet AGH). Point: ACK Cyfronet AGH, ul. Nawojki 11, Kraków (training site); the SpeakLeash foundation seat was not checked.

studio_checked: Top 30 studios by sitelinks checked by hand on 2026-11-26; an independent fact-check of 18 studios found Techland (Wrocław), Tate Multimedia (Warszawa) and Reality Pump (closed 2015), fixed in studio_place and studio_drop.

Q2066242.note: Techland: KRS seat Wrocław, ul. Jana Szczyrki 11 (KRS 0000889260, state of 2026-07-14, read 2026-11-26); Wikidata still gives Ostrów Wielkopolski

Q7687954.note: Tate Multimedia is in Warszawa; Wikidata gives Kraków
